description: Python data visualization package built on matplotlib: simple chart functions, figure composition via Panel and Grid, and a global configuration system with predefined themes
rules: Every chart function returns a matplotlib Figure; save it with datachart.utils.save_figure
Set global style with config.set_theme or config.update_config; per-chart overrides go in the chart's style parameter
Combine rendered figures with Panel (overlay on shared axes, optional dual y-axes) and Grid (grid layout, grids nest)
